## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -11.50% | 1M: -13.46%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +2.14% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND with XLK (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND provide independent confirmations.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -11.50% | 1M: -13.46%) BELOW TREND and Speculation Index (1W: +3.57% | 1M: +3.53%) ABOVE TREND point to rising risk appetite. Credit stress is a drag: HYG/LQD flagged as CREDIT STRESS ↑ while HYG (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND merit monitoring.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-accommodative: SPY/TLT is in RECOVERY (1W: +0.03% | 1M: -3.22%) while TLT (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND keeps duration relevant and Dollar Strength (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +1.62%) ABOVE TREND is mildly restrictive.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech and semis leading: SOXX (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND; Materials and Industrials also strong (Industrials 1W: +5.82% | 1M: +6.49% ABOVE TREND). Energy weak: XLE (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -9.76%) BELOW TREND — style: Growth/Momentum showing strength.

5. US vs Global?
US outperformance: SPY (1W: +2.14% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND while EEM (1W: +6.58% | 1M: +6.07%) ABOVE TREND lifts EM but China lagging: FXI (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation elevated: ARKK (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +5.34%) ABOVE TREND, IWM (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +5.29%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +3.65% | 1M: -16.47%) RECOVERY show selective risk-on positioning.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Copper/industrial metals firm: CPER (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.62%) ABOVE TREND and Industrial Strength metrics ABOVE TREND support cyclical demand; Gold GLD (1W: +3.74% | 1M: -7.13%) RECOVERY is catching up amid volatility.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy selling: XLE (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -9.76%) BELOW TREND with Brent BNO (1W: -15.49% | 1M: -24.56%) BELOW TREND, while natural gas UNG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.26%) ABOVE TREND shows mixed sub-commodity dynamics.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: VXX falling and multiple risk ETFs above trend (SPY, QQQ (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +2.36%) ABOVE TREND, XLK). Divergence: HYG_LQD flagged CREDIT STRESS ↑ and breadth only 6/11 — minor-to-moderate divergence (XRT, GLD, IBIT in RECOVERY).

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor growth/momentum exposures (XLK, SOXX, QQQ) and cyclicals showing strength (XLI, XLB) while reducing exposure to Energy (XLE) and broad commodity beta; bonds (TLT) remain relevant to hedge credit/volatility shocks.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Semiconductors/Tech — SOXX (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy — XLE (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -9.76%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals — CPER (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.62%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Oil — USO (1W: -14.94% | 1M: -23.48%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -15.49% | 1M: -24.56%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 as complacency marker, HYG/LQD ratio ~0.73 (credit health inflection), SPY/TLT ~8.58 (risk vs duration balance), Tech vs Financials level ~3.44 for style pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Tech and semis showing relative strength — XLK (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk is rising credit stress (HYG_LQD flagged) and uneven breadth—monitor HYG (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -11.50% | 1M: -13.46%) BELOW TREND for confirmation.
